native_generation_prompt:
Create one premium factual textbook editorial mechanism as a single raster PNG. Pure white backdrop, crisp vector-like rendering, subtle editorial depth, an uncluttered hierarchy, and high-contrast deep blue and warm ochre. Target exact 1200×630. Use an imaginary central 40:21 artwork area if the native canvas is taller, with blank bleed only outside that area. The exported 40:21 area must use its width and height, without letterboxing.

A contact center assistant brings matched transaction evidence and retrieved policy into case preparation for employee review.

Draw a credit-card inquiry token without text or numbers. A top lane uses matched transaction shapes and a lower lane uses policy tabs with blank fields. Both visually feed the case-preparation cradle. Only that cradle enters the employee-review station, shown as an unoccupied decision surface. A closed stub signals no automatic service decision. No refund success icon, payment release, performance chart, account balance, people or logos.

Use at least twelve meaningful forms with a distinct internal hierarchy. Print only these exact phrases, exactly once each: "Card inquiry", "Transaction match", "Policy lookup", "Case preparation", "Employee review", "Eligible requests". Bold sans serif. Priority typography at least 36px, other labels at least 28px on the 1200×630 export. Keep all labels inside 40px safe margins, outside connectors, and inside the reserved boxes. Do not print instructions, region IDs, positions or metadata.

Only these arrows, with arrowheads attached to actual object ports rather than label text: Transaction match → Case preparation. Bring matching transaction evidence into case preparation. No path from a transaction match directly to a service decision. Policy lookup → Case preparation. Include relevant policy for the case. Do not turn policy retrieval into automatic authorization. Case preparation → Employee review. Prepared information is reviewed by the employee responsible for the decision. No arrow to a refund or guaranteed outcome.

No people, humanoids, avatars, shields, gears, knobs, dashboards, logos, invented interfaces or controls, realistic photos, scenery, fake writing, decorative microstrokes, charts, unsupported numbers, success badges, permission changes or alternate implied flows. No employee replacement, mandatory refund, same-day guarantee, or performance target as a result.
